#!/bin/bash
# The warning comes from the application's own call: fs.copyFileSync makes node ask the kernel for copy_file_range, which the sandbox does not implement (it reports the call and node
# falls back to read/write, so the copy works). There is no switch to silence the report: the application must not make the call. Copy by reading and writing, then start the service again.
set -e
sed -i 's|^function copy(src, dst) {.*|function copy(src, dst) { fs.writeFileSync(dst, fs.readFileSync(src)); }|' /tmp/bench57214133/app/server.js
/tmp/bench57214133/bin/svc start
/tmp/bench57214133/bin/svc client GET / gzip

#!/bin/bash
# copy with an explicit read/write loop on file descriptors
set -e
python3 - <<'EOF'
p = '/tmp/bench57214133/app/server.js'
s = open(p).read()
old = 'function copy(src, dst) { fs.copyFileSync(src, dst); }'
new = "function copy(src, dst) {\n  const i = fs.openSync(src, 'r'), o = fs.openSync(dst, 'w'), b = Buffer.alloc(65536);\n  let n;\n  while ((n = fs.readSync(i, b, 0, b.length, null)) > 0) fs.writeSync(o, b, 0, n);\n  fs.closeSync(i); fs.closeSync(o);\n}"
assert old in s
open(p, 'w').write(s.replace(old, new))
EOF
/tmp/bench57214133/bin/svc start

#!/bin/bash
# keep the call sites, replace the implementation of fs.copyFileSync for this process
set -e
python3 - <<'EOF'
p = '/tmp/bench57214133/app/server.js'
s = open(p).read()
old = "'use strict';\n"
new = "'use strict';\nrequire('fs').copyFileSync = (s, d) => require('fs').writeFileSync(d, require('fs').readFileSync(s));\n"
assert old in s
open(p, 'w').write(s.replace(old, new))
EOF
/tmp/bench57214133/bin/svc start

#!/bin/bash
# fs.cpSync instead of fs.copyFileSync: it ends in the same system call
set -e
python3 - <<'EOF'
p = '/tmp/bench57214133/app/server.js'
s = open(p).read()
old = 'function copy(src, dst) { fs.copyFileSync(src, dst); }'
new = 'function copy(src, dst) { fs.cpSync(src, dst); }'
assert old in s
open(p, 'w').write(s.replace(old, new))
EOF
/tmp/bench57214133/bin/svc start

#!/bin/bash
# copy by read/write, but serve only the plain files (the gzip variant is lost)
set -e
python3 - <<'EOF'
p = '/tmp/bench57214133/app/server.js'
s = open(p).read()
s = s.replace('function copy(src, dst) { fs.copyFileSync(src, dst); }', 'function copy(src, dst) { fs.writeFileSync(dst, fs.readFileSync(src)); }')
s = s.replace("if (/\\bgzip\\b/", "if (false && /\\bgzip\\b/")
open(p, 'w').write(s)
EOF
grep -q 'false &&' /tmp/bench57214133/app/server.js
/tmp/bench57214133/bin/svc start
